extraction_metadata.notes: Replaces empty-experiment LLM fallback. Paper uses a quantum-inspired classical metaheuristic (QCTO) with Q-bit phase encoding and rotation gates to tune GRU hyperparameters for stock price forecasting; no gate-based QPU or simulator used.

paper_metadata.title: Optimized Stock Price Forecasting: A Deep Learning Approach Using QCTO Based GRU Network
paper_metadata.venue: 2025 International Conference on Computing, Intelligence, and Application (CIACON)

summary: QCTO-GRU hybrid: a GRU network whose hyperparameters are tuned by Quantum Class Topper Optimization (QCTO), a quantum-inspired metaheuristic encoding candidates as Q-bits with superposition/rotation updates. Applied to Bank of America daily stock prices (Jan 2005 - Oct 2021, 4122 samples -> 4027 preprocessed, 80/20 train/test). Reports MAE=0.01271, MSE=0.00976, MAPE=0.02493. Outperforms CNN-BiLSTM-Attention baseline on MAE (-28%) and MSE (-24%) but has worse MAPE. Purely classical implementation; no gate-based quantum hardware or simulator invoked.

experiments.description: QCTO-GRU stock price forecasting on Bank of America daily OHLCV (Jan 2005 - Oct 2021). 4027 samples after cleaning, 80/20 train/test (3221/806). QCTO metaheuristic (5 sections, 100 students, 100 examinations, wmax=0.5, wmin=0, C=1.2) tunes GRU hyperparameters. Benchmarked against a CNN-BiLSTM-Attention model on MAE, MSE, MAPE.

algorithm.variant: Quantum-inspired Class Topper Optimization (QCTO) driving a GRU regressor; classical simulation of Q-bit phase updates and rotation-gate qubit updates
algorithm.ansatz: Q-bit phase encoding |psi>=alpha|0>+beta|1> with alpha^2+beta^2=1; phase updates eq (8)-(9); quantum-rotation-gate matrix update for (alpha_{t+1},beta_{t+1})
algorithm.convergence_criteria: convergence of class-best performance factor or max examinations reached

problem_formulation.encoding_details: OHLCV time-series scaled to [0,1] via Min-Max. GRU hyperparameters are encoded as quantum-inspired Q-bit phases and decoded to real-valued parameters via alpha^2/beta^2 amplitudes.
problem_formulation.constraints: weight update constrained by QCTO rotation-gate dynamics

problem_instance.dataset_name: Bank of America historical daily stock price (Yahoo Finance)

dataset_specification.description: Daily OHLCV: Open, High, Low, Close, Volume. 4122 raw samples -> 4027 after cleaning. 80/20 train/test = 3221 / 806. Forward-fill for missing values; duplicate removal.

results.notes: Table III (Test Results), QCTO-GRU row. Values normalized to [0,1] feature scale.
Table III, QCTO-GRU row. Note: MAPE is worse than CNN-BiLSTM baseline.

classical_baselines.notes: Table III, baseline row. Baseline is better than QCTO-GRU on MAPE.

speedup_claims.notes: No speedup claimed; paper reports a modest empirical accuracy improvement on MAE and MSE only.

complexity_analysis.classical_complexity: Metaheuristic with O(sections * students * examinations) = O(5*100*100) = O(5e4) candidate evaluations; each evaluation trains/evaluates a GRU model.

notes: All numeric results read from Table III; hyperparameters from Table II; dataset description from Section III.C and Table I. Hardware platform not specified in paper.
